title: The tapped dual that fixes next turn over the land nobody needs
briefing: Held out for ADR 0043 (written after the fixes were tuned, never tuned against): count coloured sources. P1 has Island, Island and Forest and holds Temple of Mystery, Plains and Kalonian Tusker ({G}{G}). No land casts the Tusker this turn (the Temple enters tapped), but the Temple is the second green source for next turn; the Plains adds a colour nothing in hand uses.

reference.analysis: The Tusker needs two green sources and P1 has one. Neither land casts it now. The Temple of Mystery (enters tapped, makes G or U) gives the second green source next turn; the Plains does not help any card in hand.

options.label: Play Temple of Mystery
options.why: Nothing is lost this turn and the Tusker is castable next turn.

options.label: Play Plains
options.why: Uses the land drop on a colour the hand does not need; the Tusker waits for another green source.
